Knowledge facts: part C holds 42 fact blocks (sec05-F01 onward) from physical pages 43 to 52; part C2 holds 15 confusable and continuation blocks (sec05-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised 06/2024 cover edition, the required vision, knowledge and skills tests and the knowledge test content from physical pages 1 and 15 to 17; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- SC-PRE-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRE-A-PASS — knowledge-test passing score not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRE-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRE-A-FRESH — possibly newer unlinked manual upload not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRE-D-CHILDLAW — child restraint stages taken from the manual's summary; statute text not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- SC-PRE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- SC-PRE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the child restraint stages and code section (sec05-F29 to sec05-F33) and the driver assistance feature list (sec05-F38) can change and must be refreshed from the Buckle Up, South Carolina website and the SCDMV website.
